title: eo-claim-lint command-line report
description: The aggregated result of one command-line run over one or more claim documents. 'valid' reports whether any issue reached error severity; it is not the process exit code, which additionally depends on the --fail-on threshold.

valid.description: False when any file carries an issue of error severity.

files.description: One entry per input, in the order the inputs were given. A run that could not read every input produces no report at all, so this array is never partial.

source.description: The path as given on the command line, or the stdin label.

issue.description: Identical in shape to an issue in lint-output-1.0. Repeated here rather than referenced, because an external $ref would make validation need the network.

rule_id.description: EOC0xx document contract, EOC1xx observation and estimate separation, EOC2xx claim safety, EOC3xx provenance and evidence, EOC4xx data origin and processing. Rule ids are never reused.

path.description: JSONPath-like location within the checked document. Full JSONPath conformance is not guaranteed.

context.description: Machine-readable detail about this issue. Must not carry the checked document in full, nor any credential or personal data.
